entries.ed8f14e3cd0f81f8: Positioning itself as the region's only department store, it aims over the medium to long term to contribute to the development of the regional economy and society. It has formulated and is promoting the “IZUTSUYA Group Medium-Term 3-Year Management Plan (fiscal 2025 to fiscal 2027),” which works to raise asset value. It is also pursuing a “regional trading company” concept to diversify its earnings base. It has signed a basic agreement among three parties with the City of Kitakyushu and the Kitakyushu Chamber of Commerce and Industry, and has begun developing and selling the first product.
